test_title: PYST 38: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 1st December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

God is great / and we could / be grateful to him for all the gifts / he has bestowed on us.

options.text: be grateful to him for all the gifts

solution:
The correct answer is **and we could**.
